name: PersonalInjuryClaims
description: Manages a personal injury claim from first notification through medical evidence, quantum assessment, settlement and closure. Covers liability assessment, injury triage, treatment authorisation and rehabilitation, with interrupting lanes for emergency treatment, fraud investigation, liability denial, condition deterioration, authority escalation, complaints and litigation.

inputs.name: caseInstanceId
inputs.description: The case instance ID for this injury claim. Passed to the Get Case Plan and Get Case Rules tools.

inputs.name: folderKey
inputs.description: The Orchestrator folder key where the case plan and rules workflows are deployed.

inputs.name: caseCurrentExecutionState
inputs.description: Engine snapshot for this invocation: event, tasksRunning, tasksCompleted, stagesEntered, stagesExited, stagesCompleted and vars.

inputs.name: caseRulesDecisions
inputs.description: What the deterministic rules layer already resolved for this invocation. The agent only decides what the rules could not.

inputs.name: eventId
inputs.description: Set when an external event triggered the invocation; empty on a generic re-evaluation.

data.description: A handler or the claims console starts the case when an injury claim is notified, selecting the journey to run and the owning handler.

data.label: Claim Intake & Registration
data.description: Captures a complete first notice of loss, verifies policy and cover, screens for fraud and prior claims, and registers the claim with opening reserves.

tasks.displayName: Screen for fraud and prior claims

data.label: Injury Triage & Track Assignment
data.description: Assigns the handling track, allocates an injury claims handler, and makes first proactive contact with the claimant.

data.label: Liability Assessment & Admission
data.description: Reviews the incident evidence, determines the liability position, and tests policy limit adequacy.

data.label: Medical Evidence & Quantum Decision
data.description: Assembles the scope of works and settlement figures, takes the coverage decision and the settlement authorisation, and records both.

data.taskTitle: Confirm the coverage position on this claim
data.name: =bindings.bAPP00001

data.taskTitle: Authorise the settlement on this claim
data.name: =bindings.bAPP00001

data.label: Rehabilitation & Return-to-Work
data.description: Authorises the treatment plan, runs the rehabilitation programme to a target recovery milestone, and reviews for deterioration not evident at first assessment.

tasks.displayName: Authorise treatment plan and dispatch provider

data.label: Treatment Delivery & Provider Management
data.description: Assigns the rehabilitation provider, records the treatment delivered, and reconciles provider invoices against the authorisation.

data.label: Subrogation & Recovery
data.description: Assesses recovery potential, pursues subrogation against the at-fault party, and reconciles receipts against the paid claim.

data.label: Settlement & Closure
data.description: Confirms every open item is resolved, takes the closure confirmation, and archives the file with its retention metadata.

data.taskTitle: Confirm this claim can be closed
data.name: =bindings.bAPP00001

data.label: Emergency Treatment & Early Intervention
data.description: Dispatches emergency treatment and early intervention, and arranges care and support services where the claimant cannot manage independently.

data.label: SIU & Investigative Restriction
data.description: Compiles the screening evidence and takes a named human authorisation before any restriction is applied.

data.taskTitle: Authorise or refuse an investigative restriction
data.name: =bindings.bAPP00001

data.label: Liability Denial & Adverse Decision
data.description: Issues the adverse decision with its policy citation and the customer's external dispute-resolution rights.

data.label: Condition Deterioration & Re-assessment
data.description: Authorises the supplemental treatment uncovered during rehabilitation and updates the reserve before the claim is re-assessed.

data.taskTitle: Authorise the supplemental scope on this claim
data.name: =bindings.bAPP00001

data.label: Escalation & Authority Referral
data.description: Looks up the delegated authority available and puts the stalled decision in front of someone who holds it.

data.label: Complaint & Ombudsman Referral
data.description: Logs a complaint against the live claim and records its outcome and any ombudsman referral.

data.label: Litigation Management
data.description: Applies the litigation event code, switches the claim to litigated handling and extends its SLA expectations.
